new.title: Write an AI story
new.editing: Your earlier opening is filled in. Change anything you like.

opening.title: How does your story begin?
opening.tooShort: Add a little more. You need at least {{min}} characters.
opening.tooLong: That’s over {{max}} characters. Make it shorter.
opening.dictateFailed: We couldn’t hear that. Try again, or type it.

ideas.lighthouse: A lighthouse keeper finds letters from someone who isn’t born yet.
ideas.market: Every night the market sells a memory nobody wants to lose.
ideas.train: A night train stops at a station that isn’t on any map.

tags.title: Tags
tags.hint: Pick up to {{max}} to steer the story. They’re optional.
tags.loadFailed: Tags didn’t load. You can begin without them.

look.title: Pick a look
look.comicHint: Illustrated panels with a short narration

confirm.title: Ready to begin?
confirm.costIncludes: Includes the story plan and the first scene.
confirm.notEnough: You don’t have enough coins for this yet.
confirm.sendNote: What you write is sent to AI models from Meta to make your story.
confirm.refundNote: If a scene can’t be made, your coins are refunded.

starting.title: Making your story
starting.body: This can take a little while. You can leave this screen and come back, and your story keeps going.

player.demoSample: Demo: every story plays the same sample scenes, whatever you write. Nothing is sent anywhere.
player.keysHint: Keys: Space plays or pauses, ← and → change the panel, 1, 2 and 3 choose.
player.choicesAfter: The choices appear when the scene ends.

choices.title: What happens next?
choices.writeYourOwnHint: Free. We check it before it’s used.
choices.writeRefused: We can’t use that idea. Try something else.
choices.voiceNoMatch: That didn’t match a choice. Try again.
choices.inProgress: Your next scene is being made.
choices.blockedPath: This path can’t be drawn. Pick another one.
choices.storyEnded: This story has reached an ending, so no new scenes can be made. Scenes you’ve already made still open.

scene.blocked: This scene couldn’t be created safely. Your coins were refunded.
scene.failed: We couldn’t finish this scene. Your coins were refunded.

map.title: Story map
map.pickPath: Tap a scene to open it.
map.empty: Your map grows as you make choices.

howMade.title: How this scene was made
howMade.intro: AI models made this scene. Here is what each step used.

publish.title: Publish your story

pickPath.title: Choose the path to publish
pickPath.body: Pick the ending you want people to read. They’ll follow that path from the start.

details.title: Title
details.coverHint: We’ll draw a cover for you, or pick a picture from the story.

report.title: AI editor’s report
report.body: A quick read of your story, with ideas to make it better.
report.failed: We couldn’t make the report. You can still publish.

publish.notice: Published AI stories are free to watch and always labelled as made with AI.
publish.needsReview: Your story will appear after a quick safety check.

voice.hint: Say a letter (“B”), a number (“the second one”), or words from a choice.
voice.nothingHeard: We didn’t catch anything. Try again a little closer to your microphone.
voice.unavailableChoice: {{letter}} can’t be taken right now. Pick another choice.
voice.blockedChoice: {{letter}} is a path that can’t be drawn. Pick another choice.
voice.privacy: Your recording goes to Muse Voice Transcribe from Meta to be turned into text. We don’t store the recording.
voice.demoNote: Demo: your recording stays on this device, nothing is sent, and a sample answer is used.
voice.consentGiven: Voice input is on. Press the microphone and say your choice.

errors.notSupported: Voice input doesn’t work here. Pick a choice instead.
errors.permission: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone for ReelTale, then try again.
errors.busy: Another app is using your microphone. Close it and try again.
errors.failed: The recording didn’t work. Try again, or pick a choice.
errors.unreadable: We couldn’t use that recording. Try again.
errors.unavailable: Voice input isn’t available right now. Pick a choice instead.
